newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices remain firm, low retail demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices remain firm, low retail demand.

text.p: Indian sugar prices remained steady in a narrow price range on Thursday on low retail demand and limited arrivals, dealers said.
Demand from bulk consumers for this month's wedding season which was higher on Wednesday eased on Thursday. Supplies were thin due to limited offerings by millers.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 was quiet at 1,230/1,253 rupees while M-30 was steady at 1,250/1,312 rupees. Sugar mill delivery however slid further by five rupees to 1,145/1,160 rupees in the absence of fresh demand from outstation buyers.
